title: MechFoundry: An agentic loop that poses and performs engineering analyses and optimization of real-world objects
abstract: arXiv:2611.14571v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI agents can automate software engineering because a compiler or a test suite checks that the code does what the user or the agent intended. In engineering analysis, however, the steps that precede the computation have few easily verifiable checks: modeling a design or an object, deciding how it is used, where supports and loads are applied, and what material each part is made of. A human expert therefore makes these decisions, carries out the steps, and judges the result, one object at a time. We present MechFoundry, an agentic loop coupled with bespoke software that automates structural analyses of real-world objects without a human in the loop. From an object's lexical description, it generates a shape, poses a loading case relevant to how the object is used, assigns a material to each part, solves the nonlinear structural response, and improves the design against the loads it carries. translated_title: MechFoundry：一个提出并执行真实世界物体工程分析与优化的智能体循环
translated_abstract: AI智能体之所以能够自动化软件工程，是因为编译器或测试套件可以验证代码是否实现了用户或智能体的意图。然而在工程分析中，计算之前的步骤很少有易于验证的检查环节：对设计或物体进行建模、决定其使用方式、确定支撑和载荷的施加位置、以及确定每个部件所用的材料。因此，人类专家需要做出这些决策、执行这些步骤并判断结果，且每次只能处理一个物体。我们提出了MechFoundry，这是一个与定制软件相结合的智能体循环，能够在无人参与的情况下自动化真实世界物体的结构分析。从物体的文字描述出发，它生成形状、提出与物体使用方式相关的载荷工况、为每个部件分配材料、求解非线性结构响应，并根据所承受的载荷改进设计。一个基于自适应……构建的可微分GPU求解器（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: MechFoundry构建了一个无需人类参与的智能体循环，能够从物体的文字描述出发，自动完成形状生成、载荷工况设定、材料分配、非线性结构求解与设计优化的完整工程分析流程。
en_tdlr: MechFoundry introduces a human-free agentic loop that automates the full engineering analysis pipeline—from generating shapes and posing load cases to assigning materials, solving nonlinear structural responses, and optimizing designs—starting solely from an object's textual description.
